issues.t: Timing chain tensioners fail and the chain rattles
issues.sym: A rattle from the engine on cold starts, a check engine light for camshaft timing, and in bad cases the chain jumping and damaging the engine.
issues.why: The timing chain tensioners on the 3.6L V6 and 4.2L V8 wear out and let the chains stretch. On these engines the chains sit at the back, so the repair is big.
issues.next: Get a cold-start rattle or cam timing code checked right away. Replacing tensioners in time costs far less than a damaged engine.

issues.t: Air suspension sags and the compressor fails
issues.sym: One corner or the whole vehicle sits low after parking, a suspension warning lights up, or the ride gets harsh and uneven.
issues.why: The optional air springs crack and leak, especially in cold climates, and the compressor wears out from running too often. Ride height sensors can also fail.
issues.next: Find the leak before replacing the compressor. Some owners switch to coil springs to cut future costs.

issues.t: Carbon builds up on the intake valves
issues.sym: Rough idle, misfires, hesitation and a slow loss of power, usually from about 60,000 miles.
issues.why: These direct-injection gas engines spray fuel straight into the cylinders, so nothing washes the intake valves and carbon bakes on.
issues.next: If it idles rough or misfires at higher mileage, ask for an intake valve cleaning (walnut blasting).

issues.t: Fuel pump flange can crack and leak fuel (recall)
issues.sym: Gas smell inside or under the vehicle, sometimes near the rear seat.
issues.why: The plastic flange on top of the fuel pump can crack and let fuel or vapor escape. The first fix with butyl tape on 2007-2012 models didn't always work, so a second recall replaced the flange.
issues.next: A fuel smell is a fire risk. Check your VIN for recalls 16V-660, 18V-818 and 17V-298; the repair is free.

issues.t: Water pump and thermostat leak coolant
issues.sym: Coolant warning light, a sweet smell, the level dropping, or the engine running hot.
issues.why: The water pump and plastic thermostat housing on the 3.0T leak with age. Audi replaced pumps and extended warranty on early 2009-2011 3.0 engines through a service action.
issues.next: Top up only with the correct coolant and get the leak found quickly. Don't keep driving if the temperature climbs.

issues.t: Thermostat housing cracks and leaks coolant
issues.sym: Coolant loss, a low coolant warning and possible overheating.
issues.why: The plastic thermostat housing on the 3.6L V6 cracks with heat cycles, often around 60,000 miles.
issues.next: Replace it with the updated housing when it starts to seep.

issues.t: Supercharged V6 rattles briefly on a cold start
issues.sym: A one-to-three-second rattle right after the first start of the day.
issues.why: The upper timing chain tensioners lose pressure overnight. Audi issued a bulletin (TSB 2039995) with improved tensioners.
issues.next: Ask a dealer or Audi specialist about the updated tensioners. Audi says the rattle doesn't damage the engine.

issues.t: PCV valve fails and the engine burns oil
issues.sym: Rough idle, a whistling sound, higher oil use and sometimes a check engine light for a lean condition.
issues.why: The diaphragm in the crankcase breather (PCV) valve and its hoses age and tear.
issues.next: Have the PCV system checked if oil use rises or the idle gets rough. It's a moderate job on most engines.

issues.t: Diesel EGR, particulate filter and swirl flap problems
issues.sym: Reduced power, rough idle, frequent regeneration or particulate filter warnings, and a ticking sound from leaking injector seals.
issues.why: Soot clogs the EGR valve and cooler, short trips keep the particulate filter from cleaning itself, plastic swirl flaps can break, and injector seals leak with age.
issues.next: Take regular highway drives so the filter can clean itself, and have warning lights checked early. Broken swirl flap pieces can get into the engine.

issues.t: Front control arm bushings and ball joints wear
issues.sym: Clunks over bumps, a loose feel in the steering, or uneven tire wear.
issues.why: The Q7 is heavy, and its control arm bushings and ball joints wear out, often by 60,000-80,000 miles.
issues.next: Have the front end inspected and replace worn arms, then get an alignment.

issues.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
issues.sym: Wet carpets, water in the spare tire well, or electrical faults after rain.
issues.why: The panoramic sunroof's drain tubes clog or come loose, so water runs inside and can corrode control modules.
issues.next: Clear the drains once a year. If you find water, dry the car fully and have the modules checked for corrosion.

issues.t: MMI screen freezes, reboots or goes black
issues.sym: The infotainment screen freezes, restarts while driving, goes dark, or Apple CarPlay shows a blank screen.
issues.why: Early MMI hardware fails with age, and 2017 models had software bugs fixed by an update (TSB 2059383).
issues.next: On 2017 models ask a dealer for the MMI software update. Older units may need repair or replacement.

issues.t: Fuel injection system can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell from the engine bay.
issues.why: The fuel rails and seals may leak fuel near hot engine parts.
issues.next: Have a dealer replace the rails and seals for free under recall 15V-019.

issues.t: Oil can reach the brake booster and reduce braking (recall)
issues.sym: A hard brake pedal and less braking help.
issues.why: On some 2013 TDIs, plastic debris in a check valve lets engine oil travel into the brake booster.
issues.next: Check recall 14V-516. The dealer replaces the vacuum line and inspects the booster free.

issues.t: Rear liftgate may drop shut quickly (recall)
issues.sym: The liftgate closes faster than normal, which can hit someone.
issues.why: If a liftgate gas strut loses pressure, the power liftgate can close rapidly.
issues.next: Have the free software update done under recall 07V-334.

issues.t: Airbags and seat belt tensioners may not work properly (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptoms.
issues.why: Some airbags or belt pretensioners may not fire correctly, and software could make the front airbags deploy with too much force.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 16V-955 and 16V-519. The repairs are free.

issues.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes very heavy.
issues.why: The electric power steering control unit can short circuit.
issues.next: Have the free steering rack replacement done under recall 16V-648.

issues.t: Third-row seatback can move forward in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms in normal use.
issues.why: The third-row seatback may not hold under heavy load such as a frontal crash.
issues.next: Have a dealer install the extra support bracket under recall 16V-641.

issues.t: Steering shaft bolt may come loose (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or play in the steering.
issues.why: The bolt joining the steering shaft to the steering gear can loosen.
issues.next: Get it checked right away under recall 20V-149; loss of steering control is possible.

issues.t: Fuel rails can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell from the engine bay.
issues.why: The left and right fuel rails may leak fuel.
issues.next: Have both rails replaced free under recall 19V-035.

issues.t: Rear pillar padding may not protect heads well enough (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms.
issues.why: Padding in the rear C-pillars may not absorb enough energy if an unbelted occupant's head hits it.
issues.next: Get the free padding replacement under recall 20V-658.

issues.t: Front shock absorber forks can crack (recall)
issues.sym: A knock from the front suspension.
issues.why: The forks holding the front shocks can crack and let the shocks loosen.
issues.next: Have them replaced free under recall 19V-114.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may not inflate properly (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms.
issues.why: The side curtain airbags may not inflate correctly in a crash.
issues.next: Get the free curtain airbag replacement under recall 20V-093.

issues.t: Backup camera screen can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: No picture, or a black screen, when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Software errors and, on some 2022 models, an infotainment unit that damages itself at shutoff stop the camera image from showing.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 25V-900, 22V-742, 21V-825 and 22V-806. The fixes are free.

issues.t: Coolant pump leaks on the V6 TFSI
issues.sym: Coolant warning light and a dropping level with no obvious puddle; sometimes a check engine light with an underboost code.
issues.why: The coolant pump leaks, and the coolant can get into a switch valve. Audi describes it in bulletin TSB 2070349.
issues.next: Have the cooling system pressure-tested while under warranty if possible.

issues.t: Fuel pump can break and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Hard starting or the engine stalling while driving.
issues.why: A part inside the fuel pump can break.
issues.next: Have the free fuel pump replacement done under recall 22V-516.

issues.t: Airbag and seat belt faults on some 2020-2021 models (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptoms.
issues.why: Recalls cover a passenger airbag second stage firing too early, a door crash sensor connector that can come off, and rear center belts that stop locking too soon for child seats.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 21V-078, 20V-749 and 21V-606. All repairs are free.

issues.t: Rear trailing arm nut can break (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk from the rear, uneven tire wear, or the vehicle not tracking straight.
issues.why: The lock nut on the rear trailing arm can crack from corrosion, letting the axle go out of alignment. A follow-up recall checks the alignment.
issues.next: Have recalls 21V-295 and 22V-034 done for free.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may switch off or side airbag be mounted wrong (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag-off light stays on with an adult seated, or no symptoms.
issues.why: A loose connection at the passenger seat sensor module can disable the front passenger airbag, and the driver's seat side airbag may not be mounted properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 24V-251 and 23V-868. Both are free.
